This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
This is the repeat (second) application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.
First application M.Cr.C. No.11673/2023 was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 21.03.2023.

T h e applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with FIR/Crime No.1074/2022 registered at P.S.Panagar, District Jabalpur for the offences punishable under Section 420 of the I.P.C.
Earlier also applicant has filed an application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C., which was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to surrender before the trial Court and apply for regular bail.
Instead of surrendering before the trial Court and applying for regular bail, the applicant remained absconding.

Now again before this Court for grant of anticipatory bail on the ground that there is a compromise between the complainant and the accused persons and on that basis, the co-accused has been acquitted by the trial Court.
